test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

I said to Amit, "I am not participating in the annual function."

options.text: I said Amit that I was not participating in the annual function.
I told Amit that he was not participating in the annual function.
I told Amit that I was not participating in the annual function.
I told to Amit that I was not participating in the annual function.

solution:
The correct answer is** '**I told Amit that I was not participating in the annual function'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This sentence requires converting direct speech into indirect speech.
 
• The structure of indirect speech for an assertive sentence includes using '**that**' to connect the reporting speech and reported speech.
 
• When converting to indirect speech, the first-person pronoun '**I**' in the direct speech changes according to the subject of the reporting verb, which remains '**I**' in this context.
 
• The verb tense in the reported speech changes from present continuous '**am participating**' to past continuous '**was participating**'.
 
• **Option 3** is the correct transformation from direct to indirect speech for the given sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** Direct: He said, "I am going to the market." Indirect: He said that he was going to the market.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *I told Amit that I was not participating in the annual function*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) *I said Amit that I was not participating in the annual function.***

 
 
• The sentence incorrectly uses "said" without "to" before "Amit." The correct form should be "told Amit" or "said to Amit." Hence, the sentence structure is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Option 2) *I told Amit that he was not participating in the annual function.***
 
 
• The pronoun "he" replaces "I," which changes the meaning of the sentence. The original statement is about "I" not participating, but this option incorrectly suggests Amit is not participating.
 
 
 
• **Option 4) *I told to Amit that I was not participating in the annual function.***
 
 
• The phrase "told to Amit" is incorrect. "Told" should directly precede the indirect object without "to," making the correct form "told Amit." Thus, the sentence contains a grammatical error.
